item.title: Gambit 1.2
item.description:
# Gambit 1.2
Released November 6, 2026.
## About, fixed
- **A release build no longer calls itself a development build.** Settings › About worked out whether it was looking at a development build from the shape of the version string, and the shape it looked for — two parts — is also the shape of a release. Every copy of 1.1 therefore described itself as `· dev build` while being signed, notarized and installed like any other release. The check reads the bundle identifier now: a build that is not Gambit's own id is a development build, whatever its version looks like. That is the same line the rest of the app already draws when it decides a run is a test run, so the About panel and the app agree about what they are. - **`(build 0)` is gone.** The build number was read as a whole number, and since 1.1 the bundle's build version has been the release version — so "1.1" read as a number is nothing at all, and the panel fell back to zero. It is read as text now, and named only when it says something the version does not. Here the two are the same value, so the line reads `You have 1.2` and stops.
## Under the hood
- **The old updater stands down instead of guessing.** The updater Sparkle replaced is still in the app for the staging path, and it compared the feed's build number against the installed one as whole numbers. Reading an installed "1.2" as zero made every entry in a feed look newer. Both comparisons now read each side as a number and decline when either is not one, which is the honest answer for a version-shaped build number: this path has nothing to say about it, and Sparkle decides. - **A report says which build it came from.** The Send Feedback issue and the launch line in the crash trail both read the same field, so both were recording a build of zero. They now record the build as the bundle writes it, which is what makes a report about a specific release traceable.
## Notes for anyone on 0.1.x
The signing key for updates was rotated. A 0.1.x install will not accept this release's signature and needs one manual download — after that, updates work normally again.
